note: Adapted from the species-level description in Maiti's monograph on the world species of termites (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India); the original is in English; entry no. 81. The original notes that no specimens were available for this catalogue entry and that the characters are based on Mathews (1977). In the figure captions the author of the species name is given as 'Mathur', an OCR error for Mathews.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate resembles H. convexinotus (Snyder), H. cardini (Snyder) and H. aureus (Snyder) but differs in having 16-segmented antennae (17 in the first two), a longer postclypeus and a smaller distance between the compound eye and the ocellus; the soldier differs from H. convexinotus and the other Neotropical Heterotermes in the steeply sloping frons and the deeper median groove.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale yellow, with a yellowish brown patch on the vertex; postclypeus and antennae yellowish white; pronotum yellowish brown. Wings semitransparent, subcosta and radial sector pale yellow. Head, postclypeus and labrum with forward-directed stout long hairs and fine short hairs; pronotum with many stout hairs. Head long, sides almost straight, posterior margin semicircular. Compound eyes only weakly prominent. Ocelli indistinct, broadly oval, very close to or almost touching the compound eyes. Frontal gland pore small, above the level of the vertex. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segments 3 and 5 almost equal. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin with an incision. Measurements (mm): head length 0.77—0.80; head width including compound eyes 0.77—0.79; maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.22—0.23; maximum diameter of the ocellus 0.05—0.06; minimum diameter of the ocellus 0.04—0.05; distance between compound eye and ocellus 0.00—0.01; pronotum width 0.62—0.65; pronotum length 0.46—0.48; fore wing length 8.25—8.50.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, paler posteriorly; frons, postclypeus, antennal sockets and labrum deep yellow. Anterior part of the head with sparse bristles. Sides of the head parallel, posterior margin rounded, anterior part sloping, frons bilobed with a V-shaped groove between the lobes; the opening of the frontal gland pore lies just behind the groove. Labrum widest at the posterior 1/3. Base of the left mandible with 4 vestigial teeth. Postmentum widest near the anterior end, more than 2 times the width of the waist. Pronotum subcordate, wider than long, posterior margin straight or weakly concave. Measurements (mm): head length 1.23—1.35; head width 0.70—0.76; mandible length 0.89—0.96; pronotum length 0.37—0.46; pronotum width 0.52—0.61.
